text:
alex_cs: Heads-up: HelixCare asked for a 24h APAC-focused config for a live customer demo. They want traffic pinned to ap-southeast-2, IP allowlist on their side, session affinity (header-based), and a temporary rate-window increase. Renewal touch in ~3 weeks; demo influences renewal.

alex_cs: Requested start 2024-10-20T10:00Z, duration 24h, rate_window=800 rpm per key. Org 04K2L7D9. Masked key sk-***k9c. IPs: 45.120.0.0/16, 45.121.0.0/16. Prefer model redwood-serve-1, fallback redwood-serve-1q.

mira_se: looping infra. Quick q: reserved capacity needed? Also confirm header name for affinity.

alex_cs: No reserved capacity. They want header X-Helix-Session for affinity. I'll DM full key. Renewal risk: medium-high.

dylan_sre: We can do routing pin + header-based affinity and a scoped rate_window bump with TTL + auto-revert. Suggest fallback to ap-southeast-1 lower weight. Need full key and UTC start. We'll add alerting if p50 > 700ms.

tanya_ops: Confirming: if it's just allowlist + routing pin we can proceed without legal/commercial for peering. If they had asked for BGP, escalate.

alex_cs: They confirmed allowlist only, no BGP.

infra-bot: Created INF-5222: "HelixCare APAC pin + 800rpm (24h)" assigned to dylan_sre.

dylan_sre: Plan INF-5222: 1) pin org 04K2L7D9 to ap-southeast-2; 2) set session_affinity header X-Helix-Session; 3) set rate_window=800 rpm TTL 86400s (24h); 4) add allowed IPs; 5) fallback ap-southeast-1 lower weight; 6) add billing tag and monitoring. ETA ~90min after key.

dylan_sre: Config snippet (masked):

```
org_id: 04K2L7D9
api_key_mask: sk-***k9c
rate_window: 800
window_ttl_seconds: 86400
routing:
  primary_region: ap-southeast-2
  fallbacks: [ap-southeast-1]
session_affinity_header: X-Helix-Session
allowed_ips: ["45.120.0.0/16","45.121.0.0/16"]
```

infra-bot: INF-5222 status: in_progress (assigned dylan_sre)

dylan_sre: Applied routing pin + rate_window bump at 1770000200. Billing tag "cs-temp-apac-helix" attached. Monitoring hooks + rollback scheduled.

deploy-bot: config-change: INF-5222 completed by dylan_sre at 1770000205. Changes applied: routing.pin(ap-southeast-2), session_affinity_header set, rate_window=800 (TTL 24h), fallback ap-southeast-1, IP allowlist entries added.

alex_cs: HelixCare verified demo traffic hitting APAC primary. They ran into SDK DNS cache where older IPs were used; flushing DNS cache fixed it. Note for docs: recommend customers flush local DNS / lower TTL when whitelisting.

mira_se: I'll run post-demo checks for latency and model fallback quality. Add to post-demo checklist.

dylan_sre: INF-5222 auto-revert scheduled at 1770086600 (24h TTL). Will close after post-demo validation.

alex_cs: Post-demo feedback: execs pleased, asked for a reserved pool pricing estimate for renewal. Renewal risk reduced. Thanks team :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: INF-5222 status: scheduled_revert at 1770086600
